_readme: All words, cards, questions, and organization settings for the Social Fingerprint Index live in this file. Edit text here; the page picks up changes automatically within about 10 minutes.

cause.title: What moves you?
cause.intro: You'll see 20 cards, each an area of need in our world. Keep the ones that tug at you, set aside the ones that don't, and mark Maybe when you're not sure.

strength.title: There's more to giving than money
strength.title_named: There's more to giving than money
strength.intro: Each of us has skills and abilities that can help the causes we care about. Now let's find the things you're really good at.

cause.name: Animal Care
cause.tag: Protecting the well-being of animals, both companion and wild.

cause.name: Arts & Culture
cause.tag: Creating and sharing art that enriches communities and inspires people.
items: Arts education and youth arts programs
Public radio, television, and community media

cause.name: Cultural Preservation
cause.tag: Keeping the traditions, languages, and identities of communities alive.

cause.name: Historic Preservation
cause.tag: Protecting the places, buildings, and records that tell our shared story.

cause.name: Children & Youth
cause.tag: Helping kids and teens grow up safe, supported, and ready for life.
items: Leadership and life skills for teens

cause.name: Elder Care
cause.tag: Helping older adults live with dignity, health, and connection.
items: Home delivered meals and friendly visits

cause.name: Educational Institutions
cause.tag: Strengthening schools, colleges, and the students they serve.

cause.name: Informal Education
cause.tag: Learning that happens outside the classroom, at every age.
items: Adult literacy, GED, and English classes

cause.name: Emergency & Disaster Relief
cause.tag: Helping communities prepare for, respond to, and recover from crises.
items: Search and rescue and emergency volunteers
Long term rebuilding, at home and abroad

cause.name: Environmental
cause.tag: Caring for the land, water, and air that sustain all life.

cause.name: Family Services
cause.tag: Helping families stay strong, stable, and safe.
items: Help for single parents and kinship caregivers

cause.name: Health Research
cause.tag: Advancing science to prevent, treat, and cure disease.
items: Heart, lung, and chronic disease research

cause.name: Hospitals & Medical Care
cause.tag: Making quality medical care available to patients and their families.

cause.name: Public Health
cause.tag: Keeping whole communities healthy through prevention and education.

cause.name: Housing
cause.tag: Helping people find and keep a safe, stable place to call home.

cause.name: Hunger
cause.tag: Making sure everyone has enough nutritious food to eat.
items: School and summer meals for kids
Community gardens and fresh food access

cause.name: Physical & Mental Disabilities
cause.tag: Helping people with disabilities live full, independent lives.
items: Mental health services and support groups

cause.name: Religious & Spiritual
cause.tag: Nurturing faith, spiritual growth, and communities of belief.
items: Chaplaincy in hospitals, prisons, and the military

cause.name: Civil Rights & Civic Engagement
cause.tag: Working toward fair treatment, equal rights, and a voice for everyone.
items: Legal aid and access to justice

cause.name: Veterans & First Responders
cause.tag: Supporting those who serve and protect, and the families who stand behind them.
items: Career and transition support for veterans
Post traumatic stress and mental health care
Support for military and first responder families
Training and equipment for firefighters, police, and EMS
Honoring service, memorials, and fallen heroes

strength.name: Administrator
strength.tag: I keep things running smoothly behind the scenes, from records to schedules to the details others miss.
items: Managing volunteer schedules and sign ups
Keeping donor and member records current
Serving as secretary for a board or committee

strength.name: Artist
strength.tag: I create art, design, or stories that stir emotion and move people to act.
items: Designing flyers, logos, and event materials
Photographing or filming an organization's work
Donating artwork for auctions and fundraisers
Leading art activities for kids, seniors, or patients

strength.name: Connector
strength.tag: I love introducing people and helping new relationships grow.
items: Introducing leaders to donors, partners, or board members
Recruiting friends and colleagues as volunteers
Opening doors to businesses and community groups
Welcoming newcomers and helping them find their place

strength.name: Craftsperson
strength.tag: I enjoy building, fixing, and making things with my hands.
items: Fixing up facilities, playgrounds, and parks
Making handmade items to donate or sell at fundraisers
Teaching a trade or hands on skill

strength.name: Educator
strength.tag: I explain things in a way that helps people understand and grow.
items: Helping the public understand a cause

strength.name: Facilitator
strength.tag: I listen well and help groups think things through and find a clear path forward.
items: Running listening sessions and focus groups

strength.name: Host
strength.tag: I create welcoming spaces and gatherings that bring people together.
items: Hosting fundraisers, dinners, or house parties
Opening a home or venue for gatherings

strength.name: Influencer
strength.tag: People trust my voice and follow my lead, online and in my community.
items: Raising awareness through my platform or network
Lending my name to a campaign
Inspiring others to give or volunteer
Speaking at events or in the media

strength.name: Innovator
strength.tag: I come up with fresh ideas and bring them to life.
items: Finding new ways to raise money
Testing new approaches to old problems
Starting a new giving project or initiative

strength.name: Investor
strength.tag: I put my financial resources to work for causes, and I look for real impact from every dollar.
items: Funding a program, scholarship, or matching challenge
Impact investing and loans to social ventures
Giving through a donor advised fund or family foundation

strength.name: Mediator
strength.tag: I help people with opposing views find common ground and reach agreement.
items: Resolving conflicts on boards or in community groups
Helping neighbors and families work through disputes

strength.name: Organizer
strength.tag: I design systems and processes that make things more efficient and organized.
items: Organizing supply drives, inventory, or donation centers
Improving how new volunteers get started

strength.name: Professional
strength.tag: I share my professional expertise and business experience to help organizations succeed.
items: Offering pro bono legal, financial, marketing, or HR help
Serving on a board or advisory committee
Helping with strategy, budgets, and planning

strength.name: Project Manager
strength.tag: I lead people and projects from the first idea to the finish line.
items: Leading a service project or event from start to finish

strength.name: Champion
strength.tag: I help others see the value of a cause and inspire them to support it.
items: Asking friends, family, and colleagues to give
Speaking up for the cause wherever I go

strength.name: Social Media Expert
strength.tag: I know my way around social media and online tools, and I help others make the most of them.
items: Creating posts, videos, and online campaigns
Training staff and volunteers on digital tools

strength.name: Tech Savvy
strength.tag: I'm the one people call for help with computers and technology.
items: Setting up computers, networks, and software
Teaching digital skills to seniors or families
Helping organizations choose and use technology

strength.name: Troubleshooter
strength.tag: I solve problems and I'm always up for a challenge.
items: Stepping in when something breaks or stalls
Finding the root cause of recurring problems
Solving logistics puzzles for events and programs
Taking on the tough assignments others avoid

strength.name: Volunteer
strength.tag: When I give my time and talents, I'm living my higher purpose, and I'm happy to help wherever I'm needed most.
items: Regular shifts at a local organization
Filling in wherever there's a need

strength.name: Another Strength
strength.tag: I have a strength or skill that isn't listed here.

belief_pre.prompt: I believe I have the ability to personally make a difference.
opts: Maybe, but you'd have to show me how
I'm definitely going to be part of something big and can change the world

past12.prompt: In the past 12 months, I have...
opts: Used my professional skills for a cause
Raised awareness or advocated for a cause

why_causes.prompt: Why did you choose these three?
opts: I see myself making an impact here
I've had personal experience with these causes
They align with my beliefs and values
I felt I should choose them
I'm not sure, they just felt right

giving_align.prompt: How closely does your current giving match these causes?
opts: These are exactly where I give today

vol_align.prompt: How much does the way you volunteer today use these strengths?

barriers.prompt: What gets in the way of using your strengths to make a difference?
opts: Connecting with others who care about the same things

open_to.prompt: Which kinds of opportunities are you open to?

belief_post.prompt: Now that you've been through it: I believe I have the ability to personally make a difference.
opts: Maybe, but you'd have to show me how
I'm definitely going to be part of something big and can change the world

next_steps.prompt: What would you like to do next?
excl: I'm not ready to take action yet

comments.prompt: Anything else you'd like to share about your giving journey, or what would help you get started?

g4g.subscribe_label: Keep me informed about ways to make a difference with Gateway for Good.

Get connected to organizations that match my causes
Join a giving project with others who share my causes
Bring this experience to my family, friends, or organization
